_doc: Bodies of application WCET-E (rttools.ucxgen --bodies): the task graph, payloads and mapping of application E with work whose paths depend on the input data. work_words: words of the work array; count_max: largest count of the count body. sort: insertion sort; search: linear search of a key from the data; count: loop of (w[0] mod count_max) + 1 passes; repeat: passes of the body per iteration.
